security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.ytimg.com https://i.ytimg.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: Xenon YT Downloader is a desktop application that downloads YouTube videos (MP4, up to 1080p) or extracts audio (MP3) using the yt-dlp command-line tool. Progress is streamed live to the UI and downloads can be cancelled at any time.
